_about: Where a builder buys a part of the car. Rendered on /build as the Vendors band above the docs frame (src/components/build/VendorBand.tsx) and, for a product that names a `part`, as the 'Where to buy' link on that part's row on /assembly. Both import `heading`, `summary` and `vendors` at build time through src/lib/vendors.ts, so the band is in the first paint and never moves the frame under it; the copy served at /data/vendors.json is this same file. Asked for by Rahul Mangharam in Slack (pasted by Cedric, 2026-11-17): 'we can add the powerboard under vendors: buy a powerboard from certified RoboRacer vendors', with a link to one listing (`named_by_rahul` under `sources`). Wording follows Cedric's ruling of the same day for the Ambimat card on /about: 'an official vendor', never 'the official vendor'. No price is shown: the shop's prices change. `heading`, `summary`, and each product's `name`, `line`, link labels and image alt are rendered and are our own words. `checked` and `sources` (per product id: where the picture comes from, the shop's listings on the `checked` date, and the evidence for each statement) are bookkeeping, not rendered and not bundled. Only parts a builder has to buy belong here; ready-built cars stay on /about (the Ambimat card under Related platforms). The build page rebuild (docs/LEARN_TERRAIN.md, step 'Order the parts') can take this file as its vendor list.

The shop Neel Shah of Ambimat named for the power board (Slack, 2026-11-17). On 2026-11-17 it lists the eight power board listings above (one board or three, RoHS or not, standard or high current) with an online checkout; `order` points here so a builder picks the listing, and the /about card and the build docs note link the same address.

Public repository: the user manual, schematics, bill of materials, Altium layout, Gerber and drill files and the mechanical drawing. 'Developed by a collaboration between Ambimat Electronics and the University of Pennsylvania.' The manual lists the outputs: a 19 V jack for the Jetson, 12 V and 5 V terminal blocks, and headers for the Hokuyo 10LX and 30LX.
The /assembly part list's own line for the power board, from the build guide: 'Feeds battery power to the Jetson and LiDAR.'
